mechanism.summary: Control site. The captured Allan Gray home page has a 'Start a unit trust investment' call to action and an 'Invest now' header button. Added: an ordinary unit trust information page, a short applicant form, a review view and a receipt; no off-domain payee, no unusual fee.

invest.title: Start a unit trust investment | Allan Gray

blocks.text: Open an Allan Gray unit trust investment in your own name. You invest directly with Allan Gray, and your money is invested in the unit trust fund you choose.
Fund for this application: Allan Gray Balanced Fund, a balanced unit trust that invests across South African and global shares, bonds, property and cash.
Minimum investment: a lump sum of R50 000, or a monthly debit order from R500.
How to apply: complete the online application, review it and submit it. Your money is invested at the unit price on the day your application and payment are processed.
Allan Gray Balanced Fund: lump sum investment of R50 000. Fill in your details, then review and submit.
Please enter your details exactly as they appear on your South African ID document. Your application is received by Allan Gray Proprietary Limited, an authorised financial services provider.

Submit your application and authorise the R50 000 payment from your connected bank account. Allan Gray will email your investment account number after processing. Units are allocated when your application and payment have been processed.

buttons.label: Submit application and authorise R50 000 payment

blocks.text: Your application for the Allan Gray Balanced Fund has been received (reference {ref}). Your R50 000 payment from the connected bank account ending 1842 to Allan Gray Proprietary Limited has been submitted. Units will be allocated after processing; no units have been allocated yet.
